title: Soup Sieve: General sibling combinator inside :has() matches untrusted HTML in quadratic time (CVE-2026-126192)
description: Soup Sieve versions prior to 2.10.0 contain a performance issue where using a CSS selector with a general sibling combinator inside :has(), such as div:has(a ~ b), causes quadratic time complexity when matching against untrusted HTML with many sibling elements. This can lead to significant CPU consumption and potential denial of service by stalling the process for minutes on relatively small inputs. The issue arises because the selector engine performs nested scans without short-circuiting when the right-hand sibling is absent. A fix is available in version 2.10.0.
